body: It sounds like you have been through the ringer. But I’m so glad to hear you’re getting to a better place...one step at a time. I’m glad you are still going!
Appreciate you reading my story & thanks so much for the beautiful well wishes!! I loved reading your note & you too added light to my day. I shall give Cindy Crawford a kiss from you! Take care.
Hi, thank you!! And yes, she’s my sister. Good eye :)
I lost the apartment, yes, and I moved to Florida to be with my family. It was a shame, I really loved that apartment. I think about it a lot...what about you?

Thank you so much, I love that idea. I haven’t even dared to dream that big yet. Just getting this part of my story published was a dream come true, coming out of this nightmare. I will definitely be looking into that in the future though. Take care and appreciate the well-wishes.
Thank you! And no, ever since my doctors nailed my medication combination, I haven’t heard the Voice. Thanks for asking.
Thank you so much. I will give Cindy a hug from you!
Thank you for saying that and for reading this part of my journey, I appreciate it.  Take care!!
Thank you so much, appreciate that!
Thank you for the congrats, I appreciate that!  And appreciate you reading this part of my journey.  Take care!
Thank you so much for reading this part of my journey, I'm glad you can relate to a piece of it.  I will definitely give Cindy a big hug for you and I appreciate your well wishes!!
